scares.description: There is a loud knock at the door as Justine walks away
Justine is looking through a window when a minor jump occurs. It is anticipatable.
Justine wakes up from a dream. She sits up in bed, looks around, and when she lies back down a scary person appears on the ceiling.
During Archer’s dream when he’s kneeling beside the bed telling son he loves him the son turns into something else. Very startling and unexpected.
After James finds Willow dvd it pans up to the tv screen and he sees the reflection of the people on the couch. Accompanied by audio jump scare.

MAJOR SPOILER:

Kids in basement turn around accompanied by audio scare.
Alex steps to the side, revealing James behind him. Accompanied by an audio scare.
As Justine steps on the salt line, there is a sudden scream from behind her
Gladys comes screaming out of the darkness in the basement.
